articles.title: PLANET Technology USA launches AVS-4210-24HP4X PoE switch with 450W power budget
articles.description:
PLANET Technology USA has released the AVS-4210-24HP4X PoE Managed AV Switch, designed for professional audio-visual applications. The switch features 24 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 ports and four 10G SFP+ slots, delivering a 450-watt system power budget.
Ports 1-8 support IEEE 802.3bt PoE++ with up to 95 watts per port for devices like 4K PTZ cameras and digital signage. Ports 9-24 use IEEE 802.3at PoE+ for microphones, IP cameras, and wireless access points.
The switch incorporates IGMP and MLD snooping for efficient multicast traffic management and integrates with NDI and Dante protocols. It includes CloudViewer Pro for remote monitoring, Ethernet Ring Protection System for network redundancy, and MQTT for device communication.
A configurable Fanless Mode caps the PoE budget at 200W for silent operation in sound-sensitive environments. The product is now available through direct sales and authorised distributors.
